answer: The hollow schedule is applied in pearl and terrace exposes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 607 identities would post 3743 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
